arxiv-1810-05726.description: Abstract Robotic weed control has seen increased research of late with its potential for boosting productivity in agriculture. arxiv-2503-00677.description: Abstract General continual learning (GCL) is a broad concept to describe real-world continual learning (CL) problems, which are often characterized by online data streams without distinct transitions between tasks, i.e., blurry task boundaries. Such requirements result in poor initial performance, limited generalizability, and severe catastrophic forgetting, heavily impacting the effectiveness of mainstream GCL models trained from scratch.

arxiv-2505-06592.title: Batch Augmentation with Unimodal Fine-tuning for Multimodal Fusion of Large Language Models
arxiv-2505-06592.creator: H M Dipu Kabir, Subrota Kumar Mondal, Mohammad Ali Moni
arxiv-2505-06592.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose batch augmentation with unimodal fine-tuning for multimodal learning. We start with pre-trained unimodal models. We fine-tune the unimodal models with the application data. After that, we form a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) head that takes information from unimodal models and provides output. Finally, we train the MLP layer and unimodal parts with batch augmentation.

pmc-11975523.title: RNA结合蛋白基于RNA代谢调节在骨关节炎中发挥作用
pmc-11975523.creator: Jingyue SU, Siyu CHEN, Shengwu YANG, Zhenhan DENG, 毅 游, 征 郭
pmc-11975523.description: 骨关节炎(osteoarthritis，OA)是骨骼系统和肌肉系统常见的慢性退行性病变，目前致病机制仍不明确，因此尚缺乏有效治疗措施。核糖核酸结合蛋白(ribonucleic acid binding proteins，RBP)作为参与转录后调控的关键因子，可靶向结合核糖核酸(ribonucleic acid，RNA)并调节其功能和命运。通过对包括转录、剪接、修饰、稳定和翻译在内的RNA代谢过程进行调控，RBP可影响OA的发生和发展。探讨RBP在生理病理状态下的调控机制，阐述RBP在OA发生和发展中的作用，分析目前RBP研究的困难及未来的研究方向，对靶向RBP的OA治疗具有重要意义。Keywords: RNA结合蛋白, 骨关节炎, RNA代谢, 基因表达调控 骨关节炎(osteoarthritis，OA)是骨骼系统和肌肉系统常见的慢性退行性关节疾病，以软骨进行性破坏、软骨下骨硬化、骨赘生成、滑膜炎症等变化为主要病理特征[1]，影响全球近6亿人口[2]。随着社会的发展和人们生活方式的改变，OA的患病率持续上升，首次发病出现年轻化趋势，增加了社会经济负担[3-4]。然而，OA目前尚无治愈方案，其病理机制也尚未充分阐明。 核糖核酸结合蛋白(ribonucleic acid binding proteins，RBP)是一类通过与核糖核酸(ribonucleic acid，RNA)分子结合参与转录后水平基因表达调控的蛋白质，调节RNA的功能及命运，参与维持细胞生物学过程[5]。由于RBP具有广泛的调控作用并在真核生物中高度保守，研究人员关注到其在OA发生和发展中的潜在作用。一项人软骨RBP富集分析研究[5]显示，OA患者软骨中存在188个差异表达RBP，其中上调的RBP富集于核糖体生物发生区域，下调的RBP则富集于剪接体、RNA易位及信使RNA(messenger RNA，mRNA)监视等区域。 近年来，陆续有实验就RBP与OA的关系展开研究。目前，关于RBP在OA中作用机制的研究主要局限于个别RBP，缺乏对已报道RBP的系统性总结。本文综述了RBP在OA中的最新研究进展，归纳了其在生理和病理状态下的调控机制，从RNA代谢调控及其他角度阐述了RBP在OA发生和发展中的作用。同时，笔者分析了RBP研究中的难点并提出未来研究方向，为靶向RBP的OA治疗策略提供新的思路。 RBP及其调控机制 RBP由人类基因组编码，通过其特征性RNA结合结构域(RNA-binding domains，RBD)与编码或非编码RNA及前体RNA结合形成核糖核蛋白复合体(ribonucleoprotein complex，RNP)以调节RNA代谢[6-8]。依据功能差异，RBP可分属不同蛋白质家族，而这种差异在生物体内具有组织和细胞特异性[9]。同一组织细胞中可存在共同作用的多种RBP，同一RBP在不同组织细胞中也可发挥不同作用。睾丸是RBP富集最多的组织，所富集的RBP约八分之一与不育相关，其中包括在生精细胞中呈时空特异性表达的DEAD-盒RNA解旋酶20(DEAD-box RNA helicase 20，DDX20)[10]。与此同时，在神经细胞和少突胶质细胞祖细胞中DDX20可调节细胞活性[11]，在胃癌细胞中则可调控细胞的增殖和迁移能力[12]。 RBP控制RNA的细胞内加工、运输、降解等过程，其自身也受多种机制调控，其中RNA调节是最主要的机制。生理状态下，RNA可以调节RBP的活性、定位及功能；病理状态下，RNA可以抑制特定RBP的病理性聚集[8, 13-14]。这种参与调节的RNA可以是RBP的靶向RNA，也可以是非靶向RNA。环状RNA(circular RNA，circRNA)是RBP常见靶向RNA之一。CircRNA既可以充当诱饵调节RBP功能和细胞定位，也可以充当支架分子影响RNP组装[15-16]。长链非编码RNA(long non-coding RNA，lncRNA)中部分是典型的RBP非靶向内源性竞争RNA，通过结合RBP阻止RBP与其靶向RNA结合，从而调控RBP功能。例如，Opa相互作用蛋白5-反义转录物1与人类抗原R(Hu-antigen R，HuR)结合，可以阻止HuR与其靶向mRNA结合，抑制细胞增殖表型[17]。而另一部分lncRNA作为RBP靶向RNA，可以调节RBP稳定性及亚细胞定位。线粒体RNA加工核糖核酸内切酶的RNA组分(RNA component of mitochondrial RNA processing endoribonuclease，RMRP)与HuR在细胞核中结合，可介导HuR转运至细胞质[18]。此外，lncRNA还可以调节RBP的蛋白质翻译后修饰，影响RBP表达水平和活性[19]。除RNA外，一些蛋白质可作为RBP的分子伴侣，调节RBP的结构、定位及功能。核输入受体转运蛋白1可以阻止包括肉瘤融合蛋白(fused in sarcoma，FUS)等带有脯氨酸-酪氨酸核定位信号的RBP在应激颗粒中的积累，恢复核RBP的定位和功能[20-21]。mRNA非翻译区(untranslated region，UTR)的结构变化也会对RBP的功能及稳定性造成影响。选择性多聚腺苷酸化(alternative polyadenylation，APA)作为影响基因表达的关键机制可以改变3’-UTR长度，选择性地获得或丢失RBP结合位点，影响RBP及靶向mRNA的稳定性[22-23]。体细胞突变或种系突变可以通过多种方式直接影响RBP的功能，这些突变常改变RBD以外的功能区域；同时体细胞突变也可以通过影响UTR间接调控RBP[7](图1)。 RBP相关调控机制 Figure 1 Relevant pmc-12423865.title: Exploring Fungal Biodegradation Pathways of 2,4-D: Enzymatic Mechanisms, Synergistic Actions, and Environmental Applications
pmc-12423865.creator: Ana Caroline Barros do Nascimento, Nildo A. Nhampossa, Thaís P. Félix, Ivaldo Itabaiana, Rodrigo P. do Nascimento
pmc-12423865.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). 2,4-D (2,4-dichlorophenoxyacetic acid) is one of the most widely used herbicides globally, effectively controlling broadleaf weeds in various agricultural systems. However, its persistence in the environment and potential health risks raise significant concerns, demanding efficient and sustainable detoxification strategies. This review critically examines the fungal biodegradation of 2,4-D, with a specific focus on the enzymatic pathways mediated by laccases, manganese peroxidases, and lignin peroxidaseskey oxidative enzymes involved in the transformation of chlorinated aromatic compounds.

pmc-12463933.title: Effects of workload on 3D joint moments in cycling and their implications for injury prevention
pmc-12463933.creator: Ezequiel Martín-Sosa, Juana Mayo, Joaquín Ojeda
pmc-12463933.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background and IntroductionSeveral studies have been published in the literature analysing the effect of workload on joint moments during pedalling. Most of these studies focus on a single plane, mainly the sagittal plane, or on one joint (the knee). In this work a workload effect analysis is proposed on the three main joints of the lower body and on the three anatomical planes.

pmc-12468859.creator: Sung-Sik Han, Sang Myung Woo, Jun Hwa Lee, Joon Hee Kang, Sang-Jae Park, Woo Jin Lee, Hyeong Min Park, Jung Won Chun, Su Jung Kim, Hyun Ju Yoo, Kyung-Hee Kim, Soo-Youl Kim
pmc-12468859.description: Simple SummaryWe recently discovered that tumors rely on blood fatty acids as an energy source for growth. Therefore, we investigated biomarkers in the lipid fractions of plasma from patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) for the screening diagnosis of PDAC. We screened common fatty acid types in human and mouse plasma samples using a non-targeted approach.

pmc-12602620.title: Effect of Atogepant on Sleep Quality and Sleep-Related Adverse Events in Adult Patients with Migraine: A Prospective Observational 12-Week Study
pmc-12602620.creator: Luigi Francesco Iannone, Alberto Boccalini, Flavia Lo Castro, Daria Brovia, Marina Romozzi, Fabrizio Vernieri, Claudia Altamura, Simona Guérzoni
pmc-12602620.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundMigraine is often associated with impaired sleep quality, including insomnia, fragmented sleep, and circadian rhythm disturbances. These factors can exacerbate migraine severity and chronification. Calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP), a key player in migraine pathophysiology, also influences sleep regulation. While CGRP monoclonal antibodies have shown mixed effects on sleep, no study to date has evaluated the impact of gepants on sleep quality.

pmc-12691466.title: Integrating Functional Genomic Screens and Multi-Omics Data to Construct a Prognostic Model for Lung Adenocarcinoma and Validating SPC25
pmc-12691466.creator: Yang Zhang, Huijun Tan, Depeng Jiang
pmc-12691466.description: Simple SummaryLung adenocarcinoma outcomes vary greatly because this cancer is highly diverse, making it difficult to predict which patients need more aggressive treatment. To solve this, we combined different types of genetic data to create a new tool based on seven genes. This tool, or “gene signature,” powerfully predicts a patient’s survival chances and reliably identifies high-risk individuals.
